title: Hong Kong bilingual street names
publisher: Transport Department, Hong Kong SAR Government
sample_method: After the predeclared filters, sort unique bilingual name pairs by SHA-256('3620:' + Chinese + TAB + English) and retain the lowest 500 hashes.
filters: Both official names non-empty and not placeholders
Chinese contains CJK characters but no private-use characters
At least one English road-type token or Chinese road-type suffix
notes: The source is an official bilingual registry, not a parallel translation archive. Categories describe the observable relationship between the two official names.
